notes.title: HALF ALIVE: A NEW BEGINNING - UPDATE
notes.content:
Survivors,

The wait is over—the update is finally here ! Half Alive: A New Beginning marks the start of an exciting new chapter for the game. After countless hours of refining, optimizing, and polishing every detail, this update ensures Half Alive is smoother and more bug-free than ever before, setting the stage for everything to come.

But this is just the beginning.

What’s Next?

With A New Beginning laying the foundation, the next major update—Lock & Load—is already in the works and will bring some of the biggest changes yet, including:

 AI Rework – Smarter, more dynamic enemies to challenge your skills.
 Gunplay Overhaul – Enhanced combat mechanics for a smoother, more satisfying experience.
 Weapon Customization – Tailor your weapons to suit your playstyle.


This is just a glimpse of what’s to come, and I’m excited to share more with you soon. Thank you for your ongoing support—your feedback and dedication keep Half Alive evolving.

Stay sharp, and good luck out there.

- Tyro Interactive

notes.title: A New Beginning 1.0.0: The Next Chapter for Half Alive
notes.content:
Hello, survivors !

After months of hard work and dedication, I’m thrilled to unveil the details of the next major update for Half Alive: A New Beginning 1.0.0. This update is a complete transformation of the game, designed to deliver an amazing survival experience. While there’s no set release date yet, I’m targeting March/April 2025. This timeline allows for extensive playtesting to ensure everything is polished and as bug-free as possible. Your patience is greatly  appreciated!

I want to take a moment to address why progress has been slower over the past year. Due to personal issues, I was unable to work on the game for several months. However, I’m happy to share that I’m back in action, fully committed to making this update the best it can be. Thank you for sticking with me through it all.

What’s Coming in A New Beginning 1.0.0:

Core Improvements


 Better Zombie AI: Smarter, more reactive enemies to keep you on your toes.
 Optimization: Enhanced performance for smoother gameplay across all systems.
 Improved Graphic Resolutions: Sharper visuals for an immersive experience.
 Fixed Old Graphics Issues: Resolved problems like disappearing shadows on low settings.
 Revamped Sound Design: Footstep and other sounds have been enhanced for more realistic feedback.
 Enhanced Zombie Ragdoll: Satisfying and realistic reactions to every encounter.


Gameplay Overhauls


 Better Inventory Management: A more intuitive system beyond simple slot assignments.
 Windows for Zombies and Vaulting: New mechanics to increase tactical options and realism.
 Complete Overhaul of Mystery Box + Skull: Redesigned for better functionality and surprises.
 New Zombie Spawn System: A cumulative percentage system for more dynamic and challenging waves.
 Alternative Waves and Zombies: Experience new gameplay twists and variations.
 New Boss Wave and Arena: A high-stakes challenge awaits those who survive long enough.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507250/f08a9f27d3c27ebcf6df6adc68ede7f0663e0092.png

Customization and Systems


 Revamped Interaction System: Streamlined for easier and more immersive interactions.
 New Lobby System: Better matchmaking and pre-game setup.
 Customization System: Personalize your loadouts and characters.
 Weapon Skins: Unlock and equip skins to show off your style.
 New Store System: Includes map bundles and skins for more content options (free in-game currency).
 Redeem Code System: Unlock exclusive rewards with special codes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507250/ae253b881765896693bf3f0362501d25c6368bbc.png

Weapons, Perks, and Power-Ups


 New Weapons: P365, Beretta 35R, Model57
 Revamped Perk System: Smarter, more impactful perks.
 New Perks: Quick Revive: Get back into the fight faster. Trigger Ace: Enhance your firepower. 
 New Power-Up: Double Points for even greater rewards.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507250/c5a6ebe59e7c68df7739b2fcefb38696e6ab6194.png

UI and Systems Enhancements


 Revamped Settings Menu: Optimized and reorganized for easier use.
 Complete Overhaul of OP Machine (formerly Anvil): New functionalities and improved design.
 Lore and Secrets


With the release of this update, Half Alive will also reveal more about its lore through a dedicated trailer. Dive deeper into the story behind the zombie apocalypse and uncover hidden secrets scattered across the maps. Each map has its own mysteries waiting to be solved—will you be the one to piece it all together?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44507250/2a46ed50bd4f0fb66fa7a2213c887ef7c46e16ad.png

Testing and Polishing

Over the last few weeks, I’ve been conducting rigorous playtests to fix as many bugs as possible and ensure the update is as polished as it can be. This is a labor of love, and I’m committed to delivering a high-quality experience that meets your expectations.

Your support and patience mean the world to me. Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to launch, and feel free to share your thoughts and feedback in the community!

Thank you, and see you in the arena.

— Tyro Interactive
